_meta.note: Korean overlays for COVE.TLK. Keys are classic English as TalkTlk loads them (look after fix_look). Noun-first topicN / topicN_aliases only. See .cursor/rules/talk-locale-ko-nouns.mdc

npcs.name: Allen
npcs.job:
I know how to
enter the abyss!
npcs.response1:
The abyss
may only
be approached
by ship!
npcs.response2:
The ship must
have a magically
strengthened
hull!
npcs.question:
Hast thou such
a vessel?

ko.name: 알렌
ko.response2:
배는 마법으로
보강한 선체가
있어야 해요!
ko.question:
그런 배가
있소?

npcs.name: Frontis
npcs.job:
Welcome to Cove,
the hidden city
of wisdom.
npcs.response1:
Herein is found
much wisdom and
peace.
npcs.question: Art thou well?
npcs.no:
Visit our
healers, I am
sure they can
help thee!

ko.name: 프론티스
ko.job:
지혜의 숨은 도시
{cove}에 오신 것을
환영하오.
ko.question: 건강하오?

npcs.name: Sloven
npcs.response2:
Only the ghost
of Isaac who
haunts the inn
at Skara Brae
can tell thee.
npcs.question:
Hast thou
seen him?
npcs.no:
Stay at the inn
until he shows
himself!

ko.name: 슬로벤
ko.response2:
{skara} 여관의
유령 아이작만이
말할 수 있소.
ko.question: 그를 봤소?

npcs.name: Mentorian
npcs.response2:
Since thou dost
bear the ankh I
shall tell thee.
A gate spell
requires ash,
pearl, and
mandrake root!
npcs.question:
Dost thou
disagree?

ko.name: 멘토리안
ko.response2:
앙크를 지녔으니
말하리. 차원문은
재·진주·
맨드레이크 뿌리가 필요!
ko.question: 반대하오?

npcs.name: the ankh
npcs.response2:
One must be 8
parts avatar,
have the key of
3 parts, the
word of passage
and know the
pure axiom!
npcs.question:
Dost thou
seek help?

ko.name: 앙크
ko.response2:
아바타 여덟 부분,
세 부분 열쇠,
통과의 말, 순수한
공리를 알아야 하오!
ko.question:
도움이
필요하오?

npcs.name: Paul
npcs.response1:
I light a
candle to our
love, in love
our problems
disappear.
npcs.response2:
But all in all
we soon discover
that one and one
is all we long
to hear!
npcs.question:
Wilt thou
listen?

ko.name: 폴
ko.response2:
결국 하나와 하나가
듣고 싶은 전주요!
ko.question: 듣겠소?

npcs.name: Linda
npcs.response1:
All round the
world, little
children being
born to the
world.
npcs.response2:
Got to give them
all we can 'til
the quest is
won, then will
the work be
done!
npcs.question: Wilt thou help?

ko.name: 린다
ko.response2:
해낼 수 있는 걸
다 주고, 퀘스트가
끝나면 일도 끝!
ko.question: 도우시겠소?

npcs.name: Merlin
npcs.response1:
The black stone
is caught in a
moon gate!
npcs.response2:
Stand where the
gate of both
moons dark shall
appear. Search
when the moons
go dark!
npcs.question:
Dost thou
study magic?
npcs.yes:
Best of luck
with thy
studies!

ko.name: 멀린
ko.response1:
검은 돌은
달문 안에 잡혀 있소!
ko.response2:
두 달이 모두 어두운
달문이 나타날 곳에 서서,
달이 어두워질 때
찾으시오!
ko.question:
마법을
배우오?

npcs.name: Draconian
npcs.response1:
There are
eight possible
combinations of
truth, love and
courage. Each
of the eight
virtues is one
of those
combinations!
npcs.question: Knew ye this?

ko.name: 드라코니안
ko.response1:
진리·사랑·용기의
조합은 여덟.
각 미덕이 그
하나이오!
ko.question: 알고 있었소?

npcs.name: Blissful
npcs.job:
I know much
of the codex!
npcs.response1:
The shrine ankh
knows how to
enter the
chamber of the
codex!
npcs.response2:
Meditate at
the shrines
of honesty,
compassion and
valor for 3
cycles to know
how to enter!
npcs.question: A

ko.name: 블리스풀
ko.response1:
사원 앙크가
코덱스 방 입장을
아오!
ko.response2:
정직·연민·용맹의
사원에서 세 주기
명상하면 입장을
안다!
ko.question: A

npcs.name:
Rabindranath
tagore
npcs.response1:
In love,
all life's
contradictions
dissolve and
disappear.
npcs.question:
Dost thou seek
to carry love in
thy heart?

ko.name: 라빈드라나트 타고르
ko.response1:
사랑 속에서
삶의 모순이
녹아 사라져.
ko.question:
마음에 사랑을
품으려 하오?

npcs.name: Brother Zair
npcs.job:
I sit and watch
the river.
npcs.response2:
The kings of the
castles which
represent the
three principles
of virtue each
know but one
syllable of the
word of passage!
npcs.question: Agree?

ko.name: 자이르 형제
ko.response2:
세 원리의 성을 다스리는
왕들이 통과의 말
한 음절씩을 아오!
ko.question: 동의하오?

npcs.name: Spellbind
npcs.response1:
One must know
the combination
of the three
principles of
virtue!
npcs.response2:
The combination
of the three
principles of
virtue equals
the measure of
time and space!
npcs.question: A

ko.name: 스펠바인드
ko.response1:
미덕 세 원리의
조합을 알아야
하오!
ko.response2:
세 원리의 조합은
시공의 척도와
같소!
ko.question: A

npcs.name: Shaman
npcs.job:
I study the
'one' thing that
is the secret to
the codex!
npcs.response2:
The one pure
axiom is more
endless than the
changing tides,
more eternal
than day and
night!
npcs.question: A

ko.name: 샤먼
ko.response2:
하나의 순수한 공리는
변하는 조수보다 끝없고
낮과 밤보다 영원!
ko.question: A

npcs.name: Charm
npcs.job:
I ponder the key
to the axiom.
npcs.response2:
The 1 pure axiom
encompasses
all things.
npcs.question:
Know ye what
they are?
npcs.no:
The truths of
the universe,
the love of the
heart, and the
courage of the
soul!

ko.name: 참
ko.response2:
하나의 순수한 공리는
모든 것을 아우르오.
ko.question:
그것들을
아오?
ko.no:
우주의 진리,
마음의 사랑,
영혼의 용기!

npcs.name: Circe
npcs.response1:
The whole of the
axiom is greater
than all its
parts!
npcs.response2:
The measure of
unending love,
the limitless
courage needed
to face all
obstacles,the
truth which
encompasses all
things!
npcs.question: A

ko.name: 키르케
ko.response2:
끝없는 사랑의 척도,
모든 장애를 맞설
무한 용기, 만물을
감싸는 진리!
ko.question: A
